description: Implementation of URLRequestJobFactory class managing protocol handlers and request jobs in Chromium's network stack.

classes.name: HttpProtocolHandler
classes.description: Handles HTTP and WebSocket protocols, creating appropriate URLRequestJobs or error jobs based on request type.

methods.name: CreateJob
methods.description: Creates a URLRequestJob for the given request, returning an error job if the scheme is unknown or mismatched WebSocket request.

methods.name: SetProtocolHandler
methods.description: Associates a protocol scheme with a ProtocolHandler, allowing custom handling of URL schemes.

methods.name: CreateJob
methods.description: Creates a URLRequestJob based on the request's URL scheme, or returns an error if the scheme is unknown.

methods.name: IsSafeRedirectTarget
methods.description: Determines if a URL is a safe redirect target based on its scheme.

methods.name: SetInterceptorForTesting
methods.description: Sets a URLRequestInterceptor for testing purposes, overriding request interception behavior.
